name: pkg-script-runner
author: DeyaoCai
description: Pkg Runner monorepo — tray host + runner + editor

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @pkg-runner/assets build && pnpm --filter @pkg-runner/tokens build && pnpm --filter @pkg-runner/controller build && pnpm --filter @pkg-runner/shell build && pnpm --filter @pkg-runner/tray-ui build && pnpm --filter @pkg-runner/tray build && pnpm --filter @pkg-runner/runner build && pnpm --filter @pkg-runner/web build
scripts.dist:win: pnpm --filter @pkg-runner/runner build && pnpm --filter @pkg-runner/code-editor build && pnpm --filter @pkg-runner/tray build && pnpm --filter @pkg-runner/tray dist:win
scripts.dist:win:dir: pnpm --filter @pkg-runner/runner build && pnpm --filter @pkg-runner/code-editor build && pnpm --filter @pkg-runner/tray build && pnpm --filter @pkg-runner/tray dist:win:dir
